PLAY

Your network has been hacked and your data has been encrypted by PLAY ransomware.

We have also downloaded all your sensitive information before encrypting it.

If you refuse to cooperate, your private data will be published on our Tor leak site and shared with journalists, regulators, and your business partners.

To recover your data, contact us via the Tor network. We will provide decryption after payment is confirmed.

You can test decryption on 2-3 files for free to verify our capability.

Do not use third-party decryption tools — they will corrupt your files permanently.

Contact us through our Tor portal for further instructions.
